LESSON: SARUFI 5.4.1 HALI ZA MASHARTI -NGE- -NGALI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya masharti
2. kutambua matumizi ya hali ya masharti ya -nge- na -ngali- katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya masharti
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya hali ya masharti. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua matumizi ya hali ya masharti ya -nge- na -ngali- katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua matumizi ya hali ya masharti ya -nge- na -ngali- katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya hali ya masharti

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya masharti
2. kutambua matumizi ya hali ya masharti ya -nge- na -ngali- katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
